name.en-US: Sermon Notes of John Henry Cardinal Newman, 1849-1878
name.pt-BR: Notas de Sermões do Cardeal John Henry Newman, 1849-1878

description.en-US: The outlines Newman wrote down for his Catholic sermons at the Birmingham Oratory between 1849 and 1878, edited by Fathers of the Birmingham Oratory (1913): short notes on the Church, grace, the Passion, Our Lady, the saints and the Christian year, with the catechetical instructions he gave in 1849-60 and the editors' notes.
description.pt-BR: Os esboços que Newman registrou para seus sermões católicos no Oratório de Birmingham entre 1849 e 1878, editados por padres do Oratório de Birmingham (1913): breves notas sobre a Igreja, a graça, a Paixão, Nossa Senhora, os santos e o ano cristão, com as instruções catequéticas dadas em 1849-60 e as notas dos editores.

sources.edition: Sermon Notes of John Henry Cardinal Newman, 1849-1878, ed. Fathers of the Birmingham Oratory (London: Longmans, Green, 1913), as transcribed by the Newman Reader.
sources.description: 11 chapters: Newman Reader page numbers, navigation and its editorial remarks are dropped; Newman's own notes are kept as footnotes. Includes the editors' introduction and notes. Raw page text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Public domain: Newman died in 1890 and the text is of a Longmans impression (or earlier edition) before 1930. The Newman Reader page footers claim copyright in the site's transcription (c) 2007 NINS; a plain transcription of a public-domain text adds no authorship under US law.
